items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: One of them there is Redmond. This is Redmond, yeah.

ctx.x: Who are these three alto players?

One of them there is Redmond. This is Redmond, yeah. And this, I forget their positive name. I can't call them right off of Red. They've been so long, I'll tell you. And this is old man Albert Glennon over here. Oh yeah. Yeah, this is old man Albert Glennon, yeah.
He has his bass there on that end.
